$description: Border radii for the 'adminlte-classic' template (Classic Admin). Obtained by observing the public visual identity of AdminLTE — corners are discreetly rounded on most elements, with one notable exception: progress bars are nearly square. Original document — see ATTRIBUTION.md.

base.$description: 6px — default radius for cards, buttons, tables.

pill.$description: Fully rounded — status badges, circular avatars.

hairline.$description: 1px — used specifically for progress bars, which in AdminLTE are nearly square instead of rounded like the rest of the UI.
